sessionFilter: extract NO fact for (1) the live status of work — what was merged, pushed, committed, opened, closed, released, or removed, and what is waiting on a review or a reply — because Git and the work items already hold it; (2) anything true only for the moment, such as a next step, work in progress, or who is handling something right now; (3) a summary of what the assistant reported, found, or listed, unless the user then DECIDED something from it, and then record only the decision with its reason. When a conversation holds only such content, extract nothing at all. Keep: decisions with their reason, rules and conventions that were set, and problems with how they were resolved.
